cases.reason: Malformed BSON byte reads at EOF must return LiteException instead of IndexOutOfRangeException.
A BSON document missing only its final null terminator must not be accepted at EOF.
Mutated BSON string/binary lengths must be rejected before oversized allocation or arithmetic overflow.
Captured StringComparison modes must not reuse another translation.
Runtime enum Equals types and variable-arity initializers must stay shape-distinct.
Bound GROUP BY/HAVING aliases and fresh SQL parameters must survive template reuse.
Boolean optimizer rewrites and key-moving UpdateMany scans retain residual semantics.
Dropping a secondary index must reclaim a sentinel-only page before its collection is dropped.
A delete spanning safepoints must publish its complete empty-page chain.
Rebuild must wait for an active writer before replacing engine services.
A failure after password-changing rebuild installation must restore a matching original data/WAL pair.
Legacy read-only opens preserve bytes; lazy cutover and random commits/rollbacks preserve exact contents and the fixed legacy boundary.
CRC-valid invalid markers, header permissions and random payload bits must fail closed; page boundaries use an independent CRC oracle.
Damaged frames, stale generations and CRC-valid confirmation mutations must recover exactly the preceding committed prefix.
